references.text: Micah's hiring of the Levite as his personal priest, which provides the background for the Levite's answer in Judges 18:4
The Danites' offer to the Levite to become a priest for an entire tribe instead of just one man's household, continuing the story from verse 4
The service of the Levites and their role as priests, which explains why a Levite could serve as a priest
The support and maintenance of the Levites, explaining why the Levite was hired and received wages
The Levite's background and his journey from Bethlehem in Judah to the hill country of Ephraim, where he met Micah
